specification: Castle Security & Quality Gate Level Taxonomy

C1.name: FOUNDATION
C1.target_profile: Basic digital presence, simple static brochure sites, low operational risk projects.
C1.description: Establishes baseline engineering hygiene and release safety. Represents the minimum gate threshold.

C2.name: STANDARD
C2.target_profile: Standard commercial websites, corporate portals, content-driven dynamic platforms.
C2.description: Expanded evaluation depth across security headers, technical SEO, and Core Web Vitals.

C3.name: PROFESSIONAL
C3.target_profile: E-commerce platforms, lead generation engines, high-conversion transactional apps.
C3.description: Rigorous verification where conversion flows, user data capture, accessibility, and performance are business-critical.

C4.name: ADVANCED
C4.target_profile: Enterprise SaaS, multi-tenant web applications, data-intensive customer portals.
C4.description: High exigency with deep automated and runtime evidence, stringent security boundaries, and strict resilience.

C5.name: CRITICAL
C5.target_profile: Mission-critical operations, financial transactions, confidential personal data processing.
C5.description: Elevated verification rigor with multi-layered fault isolation, failover readiness, and zero-compromise security posture.

C6.name: ULTIMATE
C6.target_profile: Flagship enterprise platforms, high-concurrency distributed systems, maximum security tier.
C6.description: Peak quality and security gate tier within the Castle ecosystem. Zero tolerance for defects or unverified evidence.
